source: Nick, this chat, responding to blockout-0004
words: The creature's legs became a bit too thin. I wanted the concept of the creature to have a body that was structured closer to a rabbit where the rabbit's hind legs were beefier and intended to provide the bounding strength. To be clear, I don't want you to go all the way to the portion of putting rabbit legs on this creature. I'm just saying what you have here is very close, it's just a bit too thin. I'd prefer the makeup of the legs to imply better strength
direction: Modestly fuller thighs and upper calves that visually imply bounding strength, preserving the existing creature leg design. Do not replace the legs with literal rabbit anatomy.
scope: Art construction correction only; no ability or species-record change
